assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: classroom teaching opening image for beginner Cambridge AS computer science, information representation. Create a clean realistic editorial still life on a pale neutral desk: three distinct sources of information, a plain paper note with a single large uppercase letter A, a small printed photograph of a green leaf with visible veins, and a compact ordinary microphone beside a gently vibrating tuning fork (subtle motion cue only, no invented technical diagram). Three subjects laid out left to right, generous spacing, frontal slightly elevated view, wide landscape 3:2 composition, soft natural lighting, restrained deep blue and green accents. The objects should be immediately recognisable from the back of a classroom. This image introduces text, image and sound before precise digital models are taught. No binary digits, no charts, no arrows, no UI, no labels other than the letter A on the note, no branding, no watermark. Do not depict sound as a visible substance. Detailed but uncluttered, academically calm, suitable for ages 16–18.
assets.review: Visually inspected: recognisable letter A, leaf photograph, microphone and tuning fork. A source-material scene only; no claim that the photograph depicts binary storage or a precise sampling process. Labels and all exact data remain editable HTML/SVG.
assets.role: Concrete opening: text, picture and sound are different information sources.
